mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.1 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which correlates with elevated equity risk appetite and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1.1 million, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 104.0 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 104.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS above 3.5% and 3.0% respectively signal a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, suppressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 1.05 million and RSAFS > 470000, or the joint signal does not outperform individual proxies in predictive rank IC (IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and a decline in unemployment rate signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 146000 and UNRATE < 4.5%, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized signals weakening aggregate demand, which triggers equity market risk aversion and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
